title: KLUSTR v1.0
description:
KLUSTR calculates the formation rate of new particles from two compounds A and B when their pair is the critical cluster or there is no barrier. The only thermodynamic input is the formation free energy of the pair.

Contents: KLUSTR in Python and as a Fortran module, each with a test, and the ACDC simulations and KLUSTR rates of Sect. 5 of the paper. verification/acdc/ACDC/ is an unchanged copy of ACDC 2024_02_12 (https://github.com/tolenius/ACDC) under its own GPL-3.0 licence.

The model is described in Halonen, R.: KLUSTR v1.0: a closed-form steady-state model of atmospheric new particle formation from the free energy of the nucleating pair, Geosci. Model Dev., submitted, 2026.
